title: Returning an image from the computer tool in the Anthropic provider sends the content as a string

linked_prs.title: Fix computer use handling of experimental_toToolResultContent
linked_prs.body:
`experimental_content` is what `convert-to-language-model-prompt` expects. `content` isn't used and the value is silently disregarded, leading to `part.result` being stringified (see screenshot)

![CleanShot 2024-10-27 at 15 33 53@2x](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c553815-5525-45c9-85e6-260413ef5903)

Fixes #3370

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves tool invocation (the "computer" tool), LLM provider integration (Anthropic/Claude), and incorrect handling of tool output (image returned as string instead of array), which matches agent issue criteria under tool-related and LLM operation categories.
